payload.description_html: Paleobiogeography of the Tapejaridae. A. Cretaceous paleomap showing the distribution of tapejarid-bearing localities (colored circles refer to sedimentary units depicted in B). B. Jaccard similarity index applied to different tapejarid-bearing pterosaur faunas. C. Tapejarid phylogeny recovered in this paper, highlighting locality data for each species.
